hero.label: Made for Flagright
hero.headline: I want to help Flagright bring AI-native AML compliance to every fintech.
hero.subheadline: Flagright is solving a problem that actually matters: financial crime costs the global economy over $2 trillion a year, and most compliance tools are still stuck in the past. The idea that an AI-native platform can automate investigations and detect risk in real time, not patch old workflows, is exactly the kind of product I want to be selling. I am eager to bring focused outbound energy to the Texas market and help Flagright land the fintech and banking clients that need this most.

whyCompany.title: AI-native AML is a genuine leap, not a rebrand of legacy compliance software.
whyCompany.body: Most AML tools were built for a pre-AI world and retrofitted with machine learning as an afterthought. Flagright building natively on AI means the product story is fundamentally different and more compelling to skeptical fintech buyers. That kind of honest differentiation makes outbound conversations easier to open and harder to ignore.

whyCompany.title: Flagright is hiring in Texas now, when the fintech corridor is expanding fast.
whyCompany.body: Texas has become a genuine fintech hub, with companies relocating from the coasts and regional banks under pressure to modernize compliance infrastructure. Getting into that market early with a category-defining product is exactly the kind of timing that creates outsized BDR opportunity. I want to be the person building those first relationships before the market gets crowded.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this: cold outreach into skeptical B2B buyers with a technical product.
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold email and LinkedIn sequences that helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, working a product that required real explanation before it resonated. At NextAfter I sharpened my understanding of what moves B2B buyers who are protective of their budgets and cautious about new vendors. Selling AML compliance to fintechs is a similar challenge, and I am ready for it.

quote: I got into sales because I wanted to sell something that genuinely changes how a business operates. Flagright replacing outdated compliance stacks with AI is that kind of product, and I want to be the one opening those doors in Texas.
